_readme: Cases the board follows across items, grouped by topic (topics.json). Each case has exactly three stops matching the tracker's three stages: on (reached or not), text (what the stop says; for an unreached stop, e.g. 'None reported'), date (YYYY-MM-DD the stop was reached; drives 'Stories that moved this week' in the editions). items lists the board item ids the case rests on, shown as its thread. reviewed:false keeps a case off the site until a person has checked it (python3 tools/review_cases.py). tone colours the third stop: harm, policy or access. See SCHEMA.md.
